extracted.name: Baharat
extracted.description: Make your own Middle Eastern spice mix with paprika, pepper, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, star anise, and nutmeg.
instruction_lines: Combine paprika, pepper, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, star anise, and nutmeg in a bowl and mix well. Store in an airtight container for up to 6 months.
